Trust in the LORD forever, because GOD the LORD is the Rock eternal.
The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer. My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
For just as rain and snow fall from heaven and do not return without watering the earth, making it bud and sprout, and providing seed to sow and food to eat,
so My word that proceeds from My mouth will not return to Me empty, but it will accomplish what I please, and it will prosper where I send it.
As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.
From one man He made every nation of men, that they should inhabit the whole earth; and He determined their appointed times and the boundaries of their lands.
that we have heard and known and our fathers have relayed to us.
We will not hide them from their children, but will declare to the next generation the praises of the LORD and His might, and the wonders He has performed.
The Portion of Jacob is not like these, for He is the Maker of all things, and Israel is the tribe of His inheritance— the LORD of Hosts is His name.
‘You have seen for yourselves what I did to Egypt, and how I carried you on eaglesʼ wings and brought you to Myself.
He led you through the vast and terrifying wilderness with its venomous snakes and scorpions, a thirsty and waterless land. He brought you water from the rock of flint.
He fed you in the wilderness with manna that your fathers had not known, in order to humble you and test you, so that in the end He might cause you to prosper.
Please inquire of past generations and consider the discoveries of their fathers.

notes.title: Teach us to number our days

crossrefs.text: When I have brought them into the land that I swore to give their fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey, they will eat their fill and prosper. Then they will turn to other gods and worship them, and they will reject Me and break My covenant.
For you have forgotten the God of your salvation and failed to remember the Rock of your refuge. Therefore, though you cultivate delightful plots and set out cuttings from exotic vines—
When they had pasture, they became satisfied; when they were satisfied, their hearts became proud, and as a result they forgot Me.
He will call to Me, ‘You are my Father, my God, the Rock of my salvation.’
So the LORD became King in Jeshurun when the leaders of the people gathered, when the tribes of Israel came together.
When they chose new gods, then war came to their gates. Not a shield or spear was found among forty thousand in Israel.
Does a maiden forget her jewelry or a bride her wedding sash? Yet My people have forgotten Me for days without number.
They must no longer offer their sacrifices to the goat demons to which they have prostituted themselves. This will be a permanent statute for them for the generations to come.’
I ask instead, did Israel not understand? First, Moses says: “I will make you jealous by those who are not a nation; I will make you angry by a nation without understanding.”
As He says in Hosea: “I will call them ‘My People’ who are not My people, and I will call her ‘My Beloved’ who is not My beloved,”
I ask then, did they stumble so as to fall beyond recovery? Certainly not! However, because of their trespass, salvation has come to the Gentiles to make Israel jealous.
in the hope that I may provoke my own people to jealousy and save some of them.
For he walked in all the ways of Jeroboam son of Nebat and in his sins, which he caused Israel to commit, provoking the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger with their worthless idols.
This happened because of all the sins Baasha and his son Elah had committed and had caused Israel to commit, provoking the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger with their worthless idols.
They provoked His jealousy with foreign gods; they enraged Him with abominations.
They enraged Him with their high places and provoked His jealousy with their idols.
Five of you will pursue a hundred, and a hundred of you will pursue ten thousand, and your enemies will fall by the sword before you.
One of you can put a thousand to flight, because the LORD your God fights for you, just as He promised.
Do not avenge yourselves, beloved, but leave room for Godʼs wrath. For it is written: “Vengeance is Mine; I will repay, says the Lord.”
A thousand will flee at the threat of one; at the threat of five you will all flee, until you are left alone like a pole on a mountaintop, like a banner on a hill.
For we know Him who said, “Vengeance is Mine; I will repay,” and again, “The Lord will judge His people.”
The LORD is a jealous and avenging God; the LORD is avenging and full of wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on His foes and reserves wrath for His enemies.
until I entered Godʼs sanctuary; then I discerned their end.
How suddenly they are laid waste, completely swept away by terrors!
The LORD brings death and gives life; He brings down to Sheol and raises up.
Come, let us return to the LORD. For He has torn us to pieces, but He will heal us; He has wounded us, but He will bind up our wounds.
For He wounds, but He also binds; He strikes, but His hands also heal.
I am the LORD, and there is no other; there is no God but Me. I will equip you for battle, though you have not known Me,
Turn to Me and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.
Even from eternity I am He, and none can deliver out of My hand. When I act, who can reverse it?”
Even to your old age, I will be the same, and I will bear you up when you turn gray. I have made you, and I will carry you; I will sustain you and deliver you.
Our God is a God of deliverance; the Lord GOD is our rescuer from death.
